app_info.subtitle: Invites, date math, time zones
app_info.description: Turns plans into real calendar entries (downloadable .ics plus Add-to-Google-Calendar and Outlook links, no account connection) and does exact date arithmetic: business-day deadlines, days between dates, day of week, time-zone conversion and cross-time-zone meeting planning.

justifications.read_only_justification: Builds an .ics file and prefilled calendar links from the supplied event details; it does not write to any calendar or store the event.
justifications.open_world_justification: Makes no network requests; the Google/Outlook links only open a prefilled form the user confirms themselves.
justifications.destructive_justification: Cannot modify or delete existing events or send invitations.

justifications.read_only_justification: Pure date arithmetic on the given inputs.
justifications.open_world_justification: No network access or external systems.

justifications.read_only_justification: Converts the given time between time zones using the built-in zone database.
justifications.open_world_justification: No network access or external systems.

justifications.read_only_justification: Ranks candidate meeting slots from the given time zones and working hours; it does not read or book any calendar.
justifications.open_world_justification: No network access or external systems.

test_cases.description: Create a one-off invite with a reminder.
test_cases.user_prompt: Add a dentist appointment to my calendar on Oct 9 2026 at 2:30pm New York time, 45 minutes, 12 Main St, remind me 30 minutes before
test_cases.expected_output: An event card with the date, time zone and location is shown with Add to Google Calendar, Outlook and Download .ics buttons; the .ics contains the reminder.

test_cases.user_prompt: Make a calendar invite for a 15-minute team standup every Monday, Wednesday and Friday at 9am Berlin time starting Oct 12 2026, 12 occurrences
test_cases.expected_output: An event card showing 'Repeats weekly on Mon/Wed/Fri, 12 times' with the .ics download and calendar links.

test_cases.user_prompt: What date is 45 business days after October 2, 2026, skipping Thanksgiving (Nov 26) and Christmas?
test_cases.expected_output: The exact resulting date and weekday, with the number of weekend/holiday days skipped.

test_cases.user_prompt: If it's 2:30pm on Oct 9 2026 in Los Angeles, what time is it in London, Bangalore and Tokyo?
test_cases.expected_output: A table with each city's local time, abbreviation and UTC offset, marking Tokyo as the next day.

test_cases.user_prompt: Find a 30-minute slot on Oct 13 2026 that works during business hours for New York, London and Bangalore
test_cases.expected_output: Ranked slots with each participant's local time, the best one marked.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for reading the user's existing calendar.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: What meetings do I have tomorrow?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app is not invoked; it cannot read calendars.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for general history questions involving dates.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: When did the Berlin Wall fall and why?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: ChatGPT answers conversationally; no date arithmetic is needed.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for sending emails or messages.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Email my team to say the meeting moved to Friday
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app is not invoked; it does not send messages.
